about.heading: Hi, I'm Gaurav Dabral — a game programmer.
description:
I'm a Game Programmer specializing in Unreal Engine, with a focus on gameplay systems, multiplayer mechanics, VR experiences, and building modular, gameplay features.

My professional experience includes developing gameplay systems, player and interaction mechanics, multiplayer functionality, AI behaviors, UI systems, animation systems, and backend-integrated features using Unreal Engine. I also have experience in web-based game development, working with game logic, visuals, effects, and animation.

The projects below showcase my professional work, followed by personal projects and experiments that reflect my technical interests and continued exploration of game development.

proj-1.title: Slot Game
proj-1.shortDescription: Browser-based slot game developed with Phaser 3 and TypeScript, featuring responsive UI, animations, visual effects, and backend-authoritative gameplay.
proj-1.description: A browser-based slot game developed using Phaser 3 and TypeScript. The project uses a backend-authoritative gameplay architecture where spin outcomes, rewards, RTP, and spin validation are handled by the backend, while the frontend focuses on presenting gameplay results through responsive UI, animations, visual effects, and gameplay sequencing.
contributions: Implemented frontend gameplay systems and responsive UI using Phaser 3 and TypeScript
Integrated Spine animations and Effekseer visual effects
Implemented Redux-based state management for game state and UI flow
Integrated backend-authoritative gameplay systems and data
Implemented gameplay result presentation and sequencing
Optimized rendering, asset loading, and frontend performance
Debugged gameplay, UI, animation, and integration issues

proj-2.title: Multiplayer Space Exploration Demo
proj-2.shortDescription: Multiplayer space exploration game featuring replicated movement, AI, objectives, combat, and backend integration.
proj-2.description: A multiplayer space exploration demo developed in Unreal Engine 5, featuring networked spaceship movement, gravity-aware AI, objective management, combat, and persistent backend-driven player progression within a listen-server multiplayer architecture.
contributions: Implemented replicated 6DoF spaceship movement
Developed gravity-aware AI behavior for procedurally generated planets
Created an objective management system with corresponding UI updates
Implemented a replicated shooting system with object pooling
Integrated backend APIs for persistent player data and gameplay progression
Developed gameplay and UI systems within a listen-server multiplayer architecture

proj-3.title: Great Train Outlaws(GTO) - VR Co-op Shooting Game
proj-3.shortDescription: Two-player multiplayer VR shooting game featuring replicated gameplay, AI enemies, combat systems, and interactive environments.
proj-3.description: A two-player multiplayer location-based VR shooting game developed in Unreal Engine 5, focused on cooperative combat, replicated gameplay systems, AI encounters, interactive environments, and physics-driven VR interactions.
contributions: Designed and implemented a replicated VR inventory system from scratch
Developed multiplayer gameplay systems and synchronized player interactions
Implemented AI behaviors including enemy shooting and turret gameplay
Created interactive environment elements and in-world VR UI
Developed Animation Blueprints and physics-driven character reactions
Implemented ragdolls, cloth simulation, and physics constraints
Optimized multiplayer synchronization, gameplay systems, and VR performance

proj-4.title: VR Mini Games
proj-4.shortDescription: Collection of VR mini-games and exploration experiences focused on player interaction, input, animation, and exploration mechanics.
proj-4.description: A collection of immersive VR mini-games and exploration experiences developed using Unreal Engine 5, implementing VR input handling, player interaction systems, hand animation Blueprints, and rover-based exploration mechanics.
contributions: Implemented VR input handling and player interaction systems
Developed VR hand animation Blueprints
Implemented rover-based exploration mechanics
Built interactive gameplay systems for multiple VR experiences
Collaborated with designers to create intuitive VR interactions
Performed debugging and playtesting to improve stability and user experience
Optimized gameplay systems and performance for VR

proj-1.title: SKY ADVENTURE
proj-1.shortDescription: A 3D platformer prototype focused on locomotion, movement feel, and collectible-based progression.
proj-1.description: Sky Adventure is a 3D platformer prototype built in Unreal Engine 5 that focuses on core locomotion mechanics, movement responsiveness, and a collectible-driven progression loop. The project explores basic character movement such as running, jumping, and directional traversal while encouraging exploration through item collection and goal-oriented level progression. The gameplay loop is designed around simple, readable mechanics that can be expanded with additional hazards, enemy interactions, environmental puzzles, and more advanced level design.
contributions: Implemented basic 3D platformer locomotion and movement feel
Built collectible item system and progression flow
Designed a simple exploration-focused gameplay loop
Iterated on platforming responsiveness and player control
Explored level structure and pacing for a compact 3D platformer experience

proj-2.title: Endless Runner
proj-2.shortDescription: An endless runner prototype built in Unreal Engine 5 with obstacle avoidance, collectibles, and power-ups.
proj-2.description: An endless runner game developed in Unreal Engine 5 using Blueprints, featuring continuous forward movement, strategically placed obstacles, collectibles, and power-ups. The project focused on implementing core runner gameplay mechanics, player movement, and progressively engaging level design to create a fast-paced and replayable experience.
contributions: Implemented continuous forward movement and player control
Designed obstacle patterns and difficulty progression
Built collectible and power-up systems
Created replayable runner pacing and level flow
Iterated on movement feel and gameplay readability
